style: Frame from a single continuous forward-moving one-take shot. Photorealistic documentary cinematography, large-format cinema camera, physically accurate materials and light, strong forward parallax, restrained natural color, fine film grain. No text, no logos, no watermark.

clips_note: Hop clips generated 2026-11-13 with flux_3_video at 1080p, no audio, 8 credits a second. Each takes the stop before it as start_image, the stop after it as end_image, and the mid frame (when there is one) as image_references. The orbit start frame is public/film/00-orbit-live.webp imported as media ef03665d-4816-450b-bb95-acd1f0d54505. Each source is encoded by scripts/film-encode.sh into hd (1920), d (1280) and m (854) files with a keyframe every 12 frames.

clips.note: Third version, joined from three parts. Part 1 (9b2fd1d1, 7 s): plant frame to the plains frame b75973b4, with a pull-back frame (media d54c7a55, cut from the failed take) as its one reference. Part 2 (8888d064, 6 s): plains frame to a far view of the Texas factory (media 40b93551, frame 168 of the failed take), no reference. Part 3: frames 168 to 240 of the failed take 99411bfc. The slow plains drift across the join of parts 1 and 2 is sped up 2.5x. The second take (3313a902, 7 s, flew into a building at the plant) was replaced because it implied the plant and the production line were one place.

failed_takes.note: Plant to Texas in one clip with two mid frames. Came back as a shot list with hard cuts at 2.08, 2.29, 6.63 and 6.92 s. Not used. Its last 3 s (far view of the Texas factory, the approach, the door, the line) are clean and can end a retake. Both mid frames are good and can be reused as the start or end frames of two shorter clips.
